# Documentation-site dependencies (MkDocs + Material).
#
# Single source of truth for the docs toolchain, consumed by both:
#   - Read the Docs, via .readthedocs.yaml (python.install.requirements)
#   - local builds, via `make docs-serve` / `make docs-build`
#     (uv run --with-requirements docs/requirements.txt mkdocs ...)
#
# Material for MkDocs entered maintenance mode in November 2025 (security
# and critical fixes only); its successor, Zensical, reads this project's
# mkdocs.yml, so staying on Material now keeps the migration path open.
mkdocs-material>=9.5,<10

# Auto-generated reference: mkdocs-click renders the CLI tree; gen-files
# emits the element / error-code pages from the installed scrolly;
# literate-nav turns the generated SUMMARY.md files into nav sections.
mkdocs-click>=0.8,<1
mkdocs-gen-files>=0.5,<1
mkdocs-literate-nav>=0.6,<1
